A '''stunfinn''' was a deadly blood-red, long-fanged aquatic creature native to the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].

The stunfinn's organs produced a powerful electric discharge to [[Stun/Legends|stun]] its prey.

In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] was confronted by a stunfinn that had been strategically positioned by [[Rigorra]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord's]] hazardous subterranean "Impromptu Semiannual Balmorra Death Run" competition. While Fett was sure his [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] would protect him from such a shock as the stunfinn might produce, he was more concerned about the effect an electrical discharge might have on his helmet's sensors. Notwithstanding, Fett was able to jaw-wound the creature with a [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]] [[Dart/Legends|dart]] before it could inflict any damage.
